Serilog._comment: Defaults wired by UseCardscapeSerilog(). RootPath is resolved against the API content root when relative. Database.Enabled is a no-op today; the ILogEventSink placeholder ships compiled and waits for the schema ADR before flipping the switch.

Internal._comment: Service-to-service shared secret for the MCP-to-API broadcast webhook (POST /api/internal/broadcast). The MCP server is configured with the same value via Cardscape:Internal:Secret. Required in production; if absent, the broadcast endpoint short-circuits with 503.
